privacy_rule: Keep completed identity and contact fields evaluator-controlled or in the private proof vault unless the evaluator explicitly authorizes publication. Publish only a redacted receipt or its hash by default.
claim_boundary: A completed receipt can bind an evaluator-supplied record to frozen protocol, docket, authority-evidence, and signature-artifact hashes. It does not prove evaluator identity, independence, legal authority, signature semantics, result validity, field performance, or agency approval, and it does not authorize Level 5 promotion.
